# NYC Current State

The city as it stands in September 2001, for this chronicle.

## Who rules

[[Calebros]] holds the title of Prince on a caretaker basis and has done since the Camarilla victory of 1999. He has announced that he will step down by the end of the year and has asked the Primogen to settle the succession by vote rather than by violence. Nobody believes the second part will hold.

## The Primogen

- Ventrue: [[Marleina]], the clear favourite.
- Tremere: [[Hakim Olamaz]], who votes last and never says why.
- Toreador: [[Rene Valentine]], who treats the council as another party to host.
- Brujah: a rotating seat; the clan cannot agree on a representative for more than a month.
- Nosferatu: Calebros himself, until he leaves. His likely replacement is unknown.
- Malkavian and Gangrel: present in the city, absent from the council, and happy that way.

## Pressures

- Veterans of the 1999 war feel unpaid and say so.
- A small, careful hunter cell is working the Lower East Side.
- Rumours out of the tunnels have become frequent enough that even the Toreador repeat them.
- The Masquerade is thin in the clubs below 14th Street.
